_fixture_note: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA -- NOT REDISTRIBUTED CREDIBLEMEDS CONTENT. CredibleMeds/QTdrugs is licensed and its lists are NOT freely redistributable, so no real extract is vendored in this repository. This fixture is hand-authored for offline demonstration using the CredibleMeds RISK CATEGORY VOCABULARY (Known Risk of TdP, Possible Risk of TdP, Conditional Risk of TdP, Drugs to Avoid in Congenital Long QT), which is public, and drug assignments that are widely documented in regulatory labelling. In production the connector fetches from CredibleMeds under an appropriate licence and this file is never used. Treat every entry here as illustrative only.
_licence_warning: Do not replace this file with a real CredibleMeds extract. Fetch at runtime instead.
